newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: POLISH, LITHUANIAN BANKING GROUPS TO HOLD SEMINAR.
newsitem.headline: POLISH, LITHUANIAN BANKING GROUPS TO HOLD SEMINAR.

text.p: Lithuania's banks association said on Wednesday it would meet representatives from the Polish banking sector in Vilnius this week to exchange views on banking in the two countries.

"Discussions and speeches on the following issues are planned: banking regulation systems, bad loans, tax policy and central bankss supervision," the president of Lithuania's banks association, Eduardas Vilkelis, said in a statement.
The association said the meeting would be held on March 14-15 in Vilnius and would be attended by representatives from Poland's 12 biggest banks and the Polish central bank.
"Polish bankers will share their experience in organising bank mergers and establishing their ratings," it said.
Further co-operation possibilities would also be discussed, it said.
Poland's Kredyt Bank last year became the first foreign bank to be given permission to establish branch operations in Lithuania.
